details:
I would like to raise an issue regarding the notification system for VRChat’s queue system.

This is not a request to change the queue system itself. The main issue is that the current notification when a user’s turn arrives is extremely easy to miss.

When a spot in the queue becomes available, the notification is very small and disappears almost immediately. The notification sound, if there is one, is also extremely difficult to notice. It is often difficult to even tell whether a sound is being played at all.

Additionally, the queue notification does not appear to be recorded in the VRChat logs. This makes it impossible for external tools that monitor VRChat logs to reliably detect when a user’s turn has arrived.

There are also occasions where the notification message itself does not appear at all, seemingly due to a bug.

As a result, unless the user happens to be looking directly at the VRChat window at the exact moment their turn comes up, it is very easy to miss it.

In fact, I missed my turn today despite having the VRChat UI volume turned all the way up and waiting in an almost completely silent room. A notification sound that cannot be reliably heard at maximum volume is effectively the same as having no notification sound at all.

This becomes a particularly serious problem in instances where people do not leave very frequently, such as game worlds and event instances. Users may have to wait anywhere from several dozen minutes to several hours.

If a user misses their turn, they are sent back to the end of the queue. This means that missing a single notification can result in spending several more hours waiting. In some cases, a user can end up spending half a day simply waiting in the queue because they missed their turn once.

This may be somewhat manageable in VR mode, but it is extremely unrealistic in Desktop Mode to expect users to keep watching the VRChat window continuously for hours while waiting for a turn that could happen at any unpredictable moment.

Possible improvements

There are several relatively simple ways this could be improved.

For example:

* Play a clear voice announcement for several seconds when the user’s turn becomes available, rather than relying on a brief notification sound.

* Play multiple notification sounds at different points, such as:

    * when the user’s turn becomes available

    * after 30 seconds

    * when 10 seconds remain

* Display a large, persistent notification on screen while the user’s turn is active.

* Make the queue notification available in the VRChat logs so that users can optionally use external notification tools.

* Provide a dedicated notification volume or setting for queue notifications.

The most practical solution, in my opinion, would be to improve the audio notification system. Many users may be waiting in a queue while working on something else, browsing the web, or talking with friends, rather than staring at the VRChat window for hours.

The queue system can remain exactly as it is. The important thing is simply to make it reliably noticeable when the user’s turn arrives.

I believe this would significantly improve the experience for anyone using long queues, especially for game worlds and events where queue times can be extremely long.

Thank you for considering this.
title: Improve Queue Notifications to Prevent Users from Missing Their Turn
